title: fumana calycina
intro: Fumana calycina, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. The Rockrose plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Fumana calycina include its ability to act as a sedative, reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the Rockrose plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
